spans.s:
f. (-ण्डी)
A weapon, apparently a kind of fire arms or rocket.

m. (-क्रः)
A king.
E.
भू the earth, and शक्र INDRA.

f. (-द्धिः)
Purifying the ground by sweeping, burning, &c.
E.
भू, and शुद्धि purification.

m. (-वाः)
An ant or mole hill.
E.
भू the earth, and श्रु to exude, असुन् aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (भूषति भूषयति)
To decorate, to adorn.

f. (-षा)
Adorning, decorating with trinkets, jewels, &c.
E.
भूष to adorn, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-णं)
Ornament, embellishment.
E.
भूष to adorn, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be decorated or ornamented.
E.
भष, and तव्य aff.; also भूषणीय, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Adorned, decorated, dressed.
E.
भूष to adorn, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Being, existing.
2 Being well, faring well.
E.
भू to be, स्नु aff.

m. (-तः)
The planet MARS.
f. (-ता)
SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA.
E.
भू the earth, and सुत the offspring.

n. (-णं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schænanthus.)
E.
भू the earth, तृण grass, and सुट् augment.

m. (-स्पृक)
Man, a man, mankind.
E.
भू the earth, and स्पृश् who touches: see भूमिस्पृश्.

m. (-र्गः)
The mountain Sumeru.
E.
भू, and स्वर्ग paradise; a heaven on earth.
